response.overview: # The Story of Mak Chah and Mak Pah  The story follows Mak Chah or Aishah (played by Fauziah Nawi) who is eager to meet her future daughter-in-law on Hari Raya. Even before the fasting month begins, Mak Chah has already started preparing for a more festive celebration than in previous years. Meanwhile, Mak Pah or Latifah (Fatimah Abu Bakar) is anxious to celebrate Hari Raya with her youngest child after four years of him being abroad. One day, Mak Pah discovers a snake in her house. She and her husband, Pak Jamil, search frantically for it, causing chaos and commotion when the snake suddenly appears and escapes under the cupboard. The following night, Pak Jamil is aching all over, and Mak Pah persuades him to move to the city to live with their children out of concern for their safety, especially since they live at the end of the village far from neighbors, and burglaries have been increasing. However, Pak Jamil refuses as he is more comfortable staying in his own home.
